hero.title: Nitriansky technologický
hero.description: A platform that connects student talent with real-world industry challenges — and turns ambitious ideas into software products, startups, and careers.

mission.label: Our mission
mission.title: Built on four strategic pillars
mission.intro: NTI was created in response to the outflow of technological talent and the need for systematic support of innovative projects in the region. Every decision we make serves one of four strategic pillars.

incubation.title: Incubation
incubation.desc: Supporting the creation and acceleration of projects — tracking teams, applications, milestones, and outcomes from first idea to shipped product.

partnerships.title: Partnerships
partnerships.desc: Connecting companies with student talent through a structured backlog of real technical challenges, shared Product Owners, and transparent collaboration.

mentoring.title: Mentoring
mentoring.desc: Assigning experienced mentors, scheduling consultations, recording feedback, and tracking progress so every team has expert guidance throughout.

retention.title: Retention
retention.desc: Building lasting community through alumni profiles, success stories, and long-term ties to the region — keeping talent here instead of losing it.

process.label: How it works
process.title: From application to graduation
process.intro: Every participant follows a transparent lifecycle managed entirely within the platform — from the moment you register to the final project handover.

register.title: Register
register.desc: Create your account and complete your student or company profile.

apply.title: Apply
apply.desc: Submit your application with the required documents and team details.

evaluate.title: Evaluate
evaluate.desc: A commission reviews submissions against defined criteria.

onboard.title: Onboard
onboard.desc: Approved projects receive a mentor and define their first milestones.

build.title: Build
build.desc: Teams execute the project with structured check-ins and milestone tracking.

graduate.title: Graduate
graduate.desc: Deliver the final output, archive results, and join the NTI alumni network.

opportunities.label: Programs
opportunities.title: Two programs, one ecosystem
opportunities.intro: NTI runs two complementary programs. Choose the path that fits your situation — or participate in both over time.

programA.title: Grant Incubation Program
programA.desc: For teams with an original innovative idea who want to build a startup or product from scratch with funding and expert mentorship.
points: Dedicated NTI mentor for the full duration
Quarterly evaluation rounds open to new applications
Covers software, AI, web, game dev, and IoT verticals

programB.title: Live Practice Program
programB.desc: For teams who want real industry experience by working on actual company specifications with a Product Owner and paid engagement.
points: Real project specifications from partner companies
Dedicated Product Owner from the company side
Student team earns a project budget reward
NTI mentor coordinates the process end-to-end

forStudents.label: For students
forStudents.title: Turn coursework into real impact
forStudents.desc: Whether you have a startup idea or want hands-on industry experience, NTI gives you the structure, support, and community to make it happen — while still studying.

forCompanies.label: For companies
forCompanies.title: Access motivated technical talent
forCompanies.desc: Submit a real technical challenge, define your requirements, and get a student team fully managed through the NTI process — from selection and matching to final delivery and handover.

roles.label: Who's involved
roles.title: Every participant has a defined role
roles.intro: NTI's platform is built around clear responsibilities. Everyone from applicants to evaluators operates within a transparent, permission-based system.

student.label: Student / Team
student.title: Build something real
student.desc: Register individually or as a team, submit your application, upload required documents, and track your project through every milestone.
perks: Apply to Program A or B
Manage your team and invite members
Track application status in real time

company.label: Company / Partner
company.title: Sponsor a real challenge
company.desc: Register your organisation, submit a technical specification, assign a Product Owner, and follow your project from the backlog to final delivery.
perks: Post tasks to the public backlog
Define budget, scope, and expected outcomes
Review milestones and approve the final output

mentor.label: Mentor
mentor.title: Guide the next generation
mentor.desc: Accompany one or more projects as an experienced mentor — log consultations, advance milestones, and provide structured feedback at every stage.
perks: View assigned project details and documents
Provide evaluative feedback to the commission
